"""Read-only probe of context_watch.py and precompact.py at the probe head, all in TMPDIR."""
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-176/template/governance/kernel/hooks")
T = Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"]) / "probe" / "w"
if T.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(T)
T.mkdir(parents=True)
HOOKS = T / "hooks"
shutil.copytree(SRC, HOOKS, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))


def snap(root):
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in root.rglob("*")}


def transcript(path, tokens, model="claude-opus-5-5", extra=()):
    lines = [json.dumps({"type": "user", "message": {"content": "hi"}})]
    lines.append(json.dumps({"type": "assistant", "message": {"model": model, "usage": {
        "input_tokens": 10, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 0, "cache_read_input_tokens": tokens - 10,
        "output_tokens": 5}}}))
    lines += list(extra)
    Path(path).write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


def tree(name, linked, ticket_class=None, ticket_id="DAEO-x", ticket_body=None):
    root = T / name
    root.mkdir()
    if linked:
        (root / ".git").write_text("gitdir: /nowhere\n")
    else:
        (root / ".git").mkdir()
    if ticket_class or ticket_body is not None:
        (root / ".tickets").mkdir()
        body = ticket_body if ticket_body is not None else f"---\nid: {ticket_id}\nclass: {ticket_class}\n---\n# t\n"
        (root / ".tickets" / f"{ticket_id}.md").write_text(body)
    return root


def watch(root, tokens, role, ticket, model="claude-opus-5-5", sid="s1", agent=None, setdir=True, extra=()):
    tr = T / f"tr-{root.name}.jsonl"
    transcript(tr, tokens, model, extra)
    ev = {"session_id": sid, "transcript_path": str(tr), "cwd": str(root), "hook_event_name": "PostToolUse",
          "tool_name": "Bash", "tool_input": {}, "tool_response": {}}
    if agent:
        ev["agent_id"] = agent
    env = {"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "HOME": str(T)}
    if role:
        env["GOV_ROLE"] = role
    if ticket is not None:
        env["GOV_TICKET"] = ticket
    if setdir:
        env["CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"] = str(root)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-E", str(HOOKS / "context_watch.py")], input=json.dumps(ev),
                       capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=str(T), timeout=30)
    ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
    ctx = json.loads(r.stdout)["hookSpecificOutput"]["additionalContext"] if r.stdout else ""
    return r.returncode, ctx, r.stderr, ms


def show(label, res):
    rc, ctx, err, ms = res
    print(f"{label}: rc={rc} out={'YES' if ctx else 'no'} err={err.strip()[:120]!r} {ms:.0f}ms")
    if ctx:
        print("   ", ctx[:400])


before_hooks = snap(HOOKS)
print("== CTO (main tree, coordination ticket, Opus 1M)")
cto = tree("cto", False, "coordination")
show("CTO 300k", watch(cto, 300_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("CTO 849k", watch(cto, 849_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("CTO 850k", watch(cto, 850_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("CTO 860k again", watch(cto, 860_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("CTO 499k (re-arm)", watch(cto, 499_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("CTO 860k after re-arm", watch(cto, 860_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("CTO unknown model 171k", watch(cto, 171_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x", model="claude-x", sid="s2"))
show("CTO opus [1m] 860k", watch(cto, 860_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x", model="claude-opus-5-5[1m]", sid="s3"))
show("CTO opus date suffix 860k", watch(cto, 860_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x", model="claude-opus-5-5-20261001", sid="s4"))

print("== lead (linked worktree, implementation ticket)")
lead = tree("lead", True, "implementation")
show("lead 169k", watch(lead, 169_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("lead 170k", watch(lead, 170_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("lead 120k (no re-arm)", watch(lead, 120_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("lead 175k (still marked)", watch(lead, 175_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("lead 99k (re-arm)", watch(lead, 99_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("lead 175k (again)", watch(lead, 175_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
show("lead whose GOV_TICKET is the coordination ticket name but file says implementation", watch(lead, 175_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x", sid="L2"))

print("== worker")
wk = tree("worker", True, "implementation")
show("engineer 171k", watch(wk, 171_000, "engineer", "DAEO-x"))
show("engineer 171k subagent", watch(wk, 999_000, "engineer", "DAEO-x", sid="w2", agent="a1"))
show("engineer sidechain-only tail", watch(wk, 999_000, "engineer", "DAEO-x", sid="w3", extra=[json.dumps(
    {"type": "assistant", "isSidechain": True, "message": {"model": "claude-opus-5-5", "usage": {"input_tokens": 5}}})]))
show("no role, no ticket 171k", watch(wk, 171_000, None, None, sid="w4"))

print("== hostile GOV_TICKET for an orchestrator in a main tree (expect the 200k cap: reminder at 171k)")
for i, (tk, body) in enumerate([
    ("../../etc/passwd", None), ("DAEO-x/../DAEO-x", None), ("DAEO-missing", None), ("", None),
    ("DAEO-x", "no front matter\nclass: coordination\n"),
    ("DAEO-x", "---\nid: x\n" + "pad: " + "y" * 5000 + "\nclass: coordination\n---\n"),
    ("DAEO-x", "---\nclass: coordinationX\n---\n"),
    ("DAEO-x", "---\n  class: coordination\n---\n"),
    ("DAEO-x", "---\nclass: implementation\n---\nclass: coordination\n"),
    ("DAEO-x", "---\r\nclass: coordination\r\n---\r\n"),
    ("DAEO-x", "---\nclass: 'coordination'\n---\n"),
]):
    root = tree(f"h{i}", False, ticket_body=body if body is not None else "---\nclass: coordination\n---\n")
    res = watch(root, 171_000, "orchestrator", tk, sid=f"h{i}")
    print(f"  ticket={tk!r} body={(body or 'coord')[:30]!r}: reminder={'YES' if res[1] else 'no'} cto_text={'DECIDED-NOT-DONE' in res[1]} rc={res[0]}")
big = tree("huge", False, ticket_body="---\nclass: coordination\n---\n" + "z" * (50 * 1024 * 1024))
show("huge coordination ticket 860k (CTO)", watch(big, 860_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))
dirt = tree("dirt", False)
(dirt / ".tickets").mkdir()
(dirt / ".tickets" / "DAEO-x.md").mkdir()
show("ticket is a directory 171k", watch(dirt, 171_000, "orchestrator", "DAEO-x"))

print("== failure modes")
nod = tree("nodir", False)
show("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset, cwd abs", watch(nod, 171_000, "engineer", "DAEO-x", setdir=False))
ro = tree("ro", False)
(ro / ".gov-runtime").mkdir()
(ro / ".gov-runtime").chmod(0o555)
show("scratch not writable", watch(ro, 171_000, "engineer", "DAEO-x"))
(ro / ".gov-runtime").chmod(0o755)

after_hooks = snap(HOOKS)
print("hooks dir new entries:", sorted(after_hooks - before_hooks))
for name in ("cto", "lead", "worker", "nodir"):
    root = T / name
    print(name, "files:", sorted(p for p in snap(root) if not p.startswith(".tickets") and p != ".git"))

- **Ordinary work: no**, because `precompact.py` always ships beside `context_watch.py` in the kernel template, and the registration form runs the hook from that folder. Only a partial copy or a rename of the hooks reaches it.
- **Consequence: other.** One reminder is lost; nothing is blocked and no work is lost.
- **Scope:** in (S2).
- **What would reverse it:** a registration or deployment path that runs `context_watch.py` without `precompact.py` beside it would make it ordinary work, yes. Code that builds the text before creating the marker would close it.
